definition: A vector representation summarizing the semantic content of an entire document or document chunk, used for similarity-based retrieval.
details: Document embeddings allow systems to compare and search across large collections of text efficiently by reducing each document to a fixed-size vector that captures its meaning.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. In plain words: A vector representation summarizing the semantic content of an entire document or document chunk, used for similarity-based retrieval. Here is how it actually plays out: Document embeddings allow systems to compare and search across large collections of text efficiently by reducing each document to a fixed-size vector that captures its meaning. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. That care with the raw material is Document Embedding.
